prompt:
Recompose a lively night‑garden scene using the provided images only as semantic references. Center a hooded/robed statue from behind as a clean, readable silhouette. Behind it, render a CLUSTER of ORGANIC round umbrellas/lantern orbs with warm orange‑red radial patterns. Quantity target: 7–11 separate circles; several full circles visible; others may be partially overlapped; DO NOT merge them into one giant disk. Vary sizes (0.6×–1.2×), slight tilt/rotation per orb, subtle color variation, and staggered depth layers to feel alive and hand‑placed. Keep negative space between orbs so each circle reads distinctly.

Keep tall evergreens as left/right framing columns. Foreground shrubs stay lush, fresh, and alive but subdued (about −2 EV relative to the umbrellas) so they don’t steal attention.

Hard constraints:
- Remove the small sapling in front of the statue; nothing intersects the statue’s contour.
- No poles/stakes/rods/wires/scaffolding in the foreground.
- Preserve crisp circular edges and distinct spokes for each umbrella/orb; absolutely no single fused disk.

Lighting: deep night sky; warm backlight from the orbs; gentle off‑camera fill on foliage (−1.5 to −2 EV); a slightly stronger cool rim light tracing the statue edges; statue overall +0.3 EV brighter than before while retaining silhouette legibility.

Mood/details: a hint of floating dust/moths around the warm lights (very subtle, no clutter) to convey life.

Camera/look: large‑format bellows photo quality with precise perspective control, high micro‑contrast, fine film grain, natural color science, rich dynamic range, realistic optical falloff and lens bokeh. Vertical 2:3 composition; viewpoint slightly lower than eye level.

Build the layout from scratch; maintain consistent geometry/palette; single photographic exposure—no painterly style, no visible compositing artifacts.
[Guidance] Use the provided images as references with an image-to-image transformation strength ≈ 0.72 (0=loose, 1=strict).
